026public class CommodityGroundRaidObjectivePluginImpl extends BaseGroundRaidObjectivePluginImpl {
027        // for causing deficit; higher value means less units need to be raided to cause same deficit   
028        public static float ECON_IMPACT_MULT = 1f;
029        
030        public static float QUANTITY_MULT_NORMAL = 0.1f; 
031        //public static float QUANTITY_MULT_NORMAL_FOR_DEFICIT = 0.5f; 
032        public static float QUANTITY_MULT_NORMAL_FOR_DEFICIT = 1f; 
033        public static float QUANTITY_MULT_EXCESS = 1f; 
034        public static float QUANTITY_MULT_DEFICIT = -0.1f; 
035        public static float QUANTITY_MULT_OVERALL = 0.1f;
036        
037        public static int MAX_EXCESS_UNITS = 2;
038        
039        protected CommodityOnMarketAPI com;
040        private int deficitActuallyCaused;
041        
042        public CommodityGroundRaidObjectivePluginImpl(MarketAPI market, String commodityId) {
043                super(market, commodityId);
044                com = market.getCommodityData(commodityId);
045                setSource(computeCommoditySource(market, com));
046        }
047
048        public void addIcons(IconGroupAPI iconGroup) {
049                CommoditySpecAPI spec = getCommoditySpec();
050                if (spec == null) return;
051                
052                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(id);
053                CommodityIconCounts counts = new CommodityIconCounts(com);
054                
055                int deficit = counts.deficit;
056                int available = Math.max(0, counts.available - counts.extra);
057                int extra = counts.extra;
058                
059                if (available > 0) {
060                        if (counts.production >= counts.available) {
061                                Color c = Misc.interpolateColor(Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(), Misc.zeroColor, 0.5f);
062                                iconGroup.addIconGroup(id, IconRenderMode.OUTLINE_CUSTOM, available, c);
063                        } else {
064                                iconGroup.addIconGroup(id, IconRenderMode.NORMAL, available, null);
065                        }
066                }
067                if (deficit > 0) {
068                        iconGroup.addIconGroup(id, IconRenderMode.RED, deficit, null);
069                }
070                if (extra > 0) {
071                        iconGroup.addIconGroup(id, IconRenderMode.GREEN, extra, null);
072                }
073        }

075        public int getCargoSpaceNeeded() {
076                CommoditySpecAPI spec = getCommoditySpec();
077                if (!spec.isFuel() && !spec.isPersonnel()) {
078                        return (int) (spec.getCargoSpace() * getQuantity(getMarinesAssigned()));
079                }
080                return 0;
081        }
082        
083        public int getFuelSpaceNeeded() {
084                CommoditySpecAPI spec = getCommoditySpec();
085                if (spec.isFuel()) {
086                        return (int) (spec.getCargoSpace() * getQuantity(getMarinesAssigned()));
087                }
088                return 0;
089        }
090        
091        public int getProjectedCreditsValue() {
092                CommoditySpecAPI spec = getCommoditySpec();
093                return (int) (spec.getBasePrice() * getQuantity(getMarinesAssigned()));
094        }
095        
096        public int getDeficitCaused() {
097                float quantity = getQuantity(getMarinesAssigned(), true);
098                quantity *= ECON_IMPACT_MULT;
099                int diff = Misc.computeEconUnitChangeFromTradeModChange(com, -(int)quantity);
100                diff = -diff;
101                if (diff < 0) diff = 0;
102                if (diff == 0 && getProjectedCreditsValue() > 1000) diff = 1;
103                return diff;
104        }
105        
106        public CommoditySpecAPI getCommoditySpec() {
107                return com.getCommodity();
108        }
109        
110        public RaidDangerLevel getDangerLevel() {
111//              if (id.equals(Commodities.HAND_WEAPONS)) {
112//                      System.out.println("wefwefwe");
113//              }
114                RaidDangerLevel danger = com.getCommodity().getBaseDanger();
115                CommodityIconCounts counts = new CommodityIconCounts(com);
116                if (counts.production >= counts.available) {
117                        danger = danger.prev();
118                }
119                if (counts.deficit > 0) {
120                        danger = danger.next();
121                }
122                if (counts.extra > 0) {
123                        danger = danger.prev();
124                }
125                if (source != null) {
126                        danger = source.adjustCommodityDangerLevel(id, danger);
127                }
128                return danger;
129        }

139        public float getQuantity(int marines, boolean forDeficit) {

148        
149        public float getBaseRaidQuantity(boolean forDeficit) {
150                //CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(id);
151                float unit = com.getCommodity().getEconUnit();
152                
153                CommodityIconCounts counts = new CommodityIconCounts(com);
154                
155                float result = 0f;
156                
157                if (counts.extra > MAX_EXCESS_UNITS) {
158                        counts.extra = MAX_EXCESS_UNITS;
159                }
160                
161                if (forDeficit) {
162                        result += Math.max(0, counts.available - counts.extra) * unit * QUANTITY_MULT_NORMAL_FOR_DEFICIT;
163                } else {
164                        result += Math.max(0, counts.available - counts.extra) * unit * QUANTITY_MULT_NORMAL;
165                }
166                result += counts.extra * unit * QUANTITY_MULT_EXCESS;
167                result += counts.deficit * unit * QUANTITY_MULT_DEFICIT;
168                
169                result *= QUANTITY_MULT_OVERALL;
170                
171                if (result < 0) result = 0;
172                
173                return result;
174        }
175
176        public static Industry computeCommoditySource(MarketAPI market, CommodityOnMarketAPI com) {
177                Industry best = null;
178                int score = 0;
179                int available = com.getAvailable();
180                RaidDangerLevel base = com.getCommodity().getBaseDanger();
181                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
182                        int supply = ind.getSupply(com.getId()).getQuantity().getModifiedInt();
183                        int metDemand = Math.min(available, ind.getDemand(com.getId()).getQuantity().getModifiedInt());
184                        int currScore = Math.max(supply, metDemand) * 1000;
185                        RaidDangerLevel danger = ind.adjustCommodityDangerLevel(com.getId(), base);
186                        currScore += 1000 - danger.ordinal();
187                        if (currScore > score) {
188                                score = currScore;
189                                best = ind;
190                        }
191                }
192                return best;
193        }

209        public int performRaid(CargoAPI loot, Random random, float lootMult, TextPanelAPI text) {
210                if (marinesAssigned <= 0) return 0;
211                
212                float base = getQuantity(marinesAssigned);
213                base *= lootMult;
214                
215                float mult = 0.9f + random.nextFloat() * 0.2f;
216                base *= mult;
217                
218                quantityLooted = (int) base;
219                if (quantityLooted < 1) quantityLooted = 1;
220                
221                loot.addCommodity(getId(), quantityLooted);
222                
223                deficitActuallyCaused = getDeficitCaused();
224                if (deficitActuallyCaused > 0) {
225                        com.getAvailableStat().addTemporaryModFlat(
226                                        ShippingDisruption.ACCESS_LOSS_DURATION,
227                                        Misc.genUID(), "Recent raid", -deficitActuallyCaused);
228                }
229                
230                xpGained = (int) (quantityLooted * getCommoditySpec().getBasePrice() * XP_GAIN_VALUE_MULT);
231                return xpGained;
232        }
